title: Audit summary
description: The one machine-readable file the agent writes. The human-readable summary and the notification are both rendered FROM this file (scripts/render-summary.mjs) -- never authored separately -- so they cannot describe different runs. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's 'summary contract' section for why each rule below exists.

modules.description: One entry per module touched by an in-scope PR. Rule: every in-scope PR must appear against some module's driven_by -- a single module with empty lists must not be able to close a cycle in which others were never examined (validate-summary.mjs's coverage guard checks this).

name.description: Accepts the synonym 'module' at the top level -- see render-summary.mjs's vocabulary normalization.

driven_by.description: The PR(s) that drove this module's audit, e.g. '#534, #557'.

no_change.description: Count of existing cases audited and left alone. Never stated independently elsewhere -- it IS the number other renderers read.

grounding.description: Every factual/numeric claim anywhere in this file must have a grounding entry. validate-summary.mjs opens `file` and checks `excerpt` appears verbatim at or near `line`.

file.description: Path relative to repo root. Documentation files need a line number too, not only source.

excerpt.description: One REAL line, verbatim. Never a multi-line construct reassembled onto one line -- that text exists nowhere and the grounding check will correctly fail it.

no_action_reason.description: REQUIRED whenever every module's created/updated/deprecated arrays are empty (validate-summary.mjs enforces this -- an absent field in that situation is itself a validation failure, not a pass).

kind.description: nothing-needed: audited everything in scope, catalogue already correct -- cycle closes. blocked: something prevented writing (refused command, bad token) -- issue stays open, PRs stay queued. incomplete: ran out of room before auditing everything -- issue stays open, PRs stay queued.

conflicts.description: Cases where the agent found disagreeing sources of truth (e.g. two docs disagreeing about a count) and had to pick one. Empty array, not omitted, when there are none.

judgement_calls.description: Places the agent made a call it wants a human to double-check -- e.g. declining to update a case it could not confidently match. This is the agent's uncertainty channel; treat a non-empty array as a signal worth a human's attention, never as a failure.

item_id.description: Must resolve in the store -- validate-summary.mjs's existence-resolution guard checks every id here, in updated[], and in deprecated[].

reason.description: What changed, in user-facing terms -- accepts the synonym 'reason_for_updating'.
